Coram : BHUSHAN RAMKRISHNA GAVAI*, J.B. PARDIWALA, SANJAY KUMAR
HEADNOTES Issue for consideration: In a case based on circumstantial evidence as there was no eyewitness to the kidnapping and murder, and where the prosecution’s case essentially turned upon the ‘recoveries’ made at the behest of the Evidence Act, whether their conviction on diff erent counts and death sentence imposed on two out of the three appellants was justifi ed, when the confessions were made before their arrest and prior to being ‘accused of any off ence’. Evidence Act, 1872 – ss.26, 27 – Being
Decision Date : 21-09-2023 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 793/2022 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
